seo.title: Contact Atlaxys | Start a Software Project
seo.description: Tell us about your project. Reach Atlaxys Consulting by form, email or WhatsApp about software, AI automation, cloud hosting or technical advice.

hero.title: Tell us what you are building.
hero.lead: A few details help us come back with useful questions and, when it makes sense, a first estimate. Prefer to talk? WhatsApp and email work just as well.

channels.title: Contact us directly
channels.emailText: For project briefs, tenders and documents.
channels.whatsappText: For quick questions and booking a call.

next.title: What happens next
steps: We read your message and reply, usually within one working day, often with a few questions.
We schedule a 30-minute call to understand the problem, your constraints and your timeline. No preparation needed.
We send a written proposal: our approach, the project phases, a price range and the assumptions behind it.

thankYou.title: Thank you. We have your message.
thankYou.text: Someone from our team will reply by email, usually within one working day. If it is urgent, WhatsApp is the fastest way to reach us.

items.question: What should I include in my message?
items.answer: What you want the software to do, who will use it, the tools you already rely on and any deadline you have in mind. A rough idea is enough: we ask the questions that fill the gaps.

items.question: Do you work with clients outside Morocco?
items.answer: Yes. We are based in Morocco and work with clients in Morocco and abroad. Most collaboration happens remotely, by video call, email and WhatsApp, with on-site meetings when a project needs them.

items.question: Which languages can we use?
items.answer: English, French or Arabic, in writing and on calls. Write to us in whichever is easiest for you.

items.question: Will I know the price before committing?
items.answer: Yes. After the first call we send a written proposal with our approach, the project phases, a price range and the assumptions behind it. You then decide whether to go ahead.
